biography.plain_text: Max Verstappen is a Dutch Formula One driver and four-time world champion with Red Bull Racing. After progressing rapidly through karting and single-seaters, he became Formula One's youngest race winner in 2016. Titles from 2021 through 2024 established him as the Netherlands' first champion and one of his generation's defining competitors.

long_biography.plain_text:
Verstappen grew up in a motorsport family and won major European and world karting titles before moving directly into Formula Three. Red Bull recruited him after one single-seater season, and Toro Rosso gave him his Formula One debut at 17. Promotion to the senior team produced an immediate Spanish Grand Prix victory, making him the championship's youngest winner.

His first drivers' title came in the final race of 2021. Two dominant campaigns followed, including a record 19 victories in one season, before a tighter contest yielded a fourth consecutive crown. Still racing for Red Bull, Verstappen has also co-founded a programme spanning GT competition, sim racing and driver development, broadening his role beyond the Formula One cockpit.
long_biography.html:
Verstappen grew up in a motorsport family and won major European and world karting titles before moving directly into Formula Three. Red Bull recruited him after one single-seater season, and Toro Rosso gave him his Formula One debut at 17. Promotion to the senior team produced an immediate Spanish Grand Prix victory, making him the championship's youngest winner.

His first drivers' title came in the final race of 2021. Two dominant campaigns followed, including a record 19 victories in one season, before a tighter contest yielded a fourth consecutive crown. Still racing for Red Bull, Verstappen has also co-founded a programme spanning GT competition, sim racing and driver development, broadening his role beyond the Formula One cockpit.
